mcq_fix.s: Besides the grain market and the cloth market (Sarai-i-Adl), which other market did Alauddin Khalji regulate?
mcq_fix.why: 'third market' ordinal is arbitrary/ambiguous (grain market is also an option)

mcq_drop.why: oddly worded (unexplained 'MBT' in options); dubious - Islam reached coastal Andhra earlier via traders

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: same UPSC 2002 item as y9b73b8cdf4a, correct answer is 3 (Sultan framed own regulations), not 1

patterns: Only PYQs are UPSC 2002 on Barani: state not truly Islamic because the Sultan framed his own regulations (zawabit) - a recurring reason-type question.
Exam-style facts that recur in other PSCs: Kulah-daran = Sayyids, Dastar-bandan = Ulema, Khusrau Shah's palace idol-worship, Alauddin vs Firoz on the ulema.
App MCQs are heavy on multi-statement historiography (conversion theories, temple-destruction motives) - beyond APPSC's direct-fact style.
App's AP tilt (Qutb Shahi jizya, Akkanna-Madanna, Bhadrachalam, Gesu Daraz) is well suited to APPSC.
